spec.name: Show HN: Filebrowser Alternative
spec.description: Show HN: I made an alternative to the archived filebrowser. This project showcases how to create a modern, lightweight file browser using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
spec.problem: This project is a fun learning exercise to demonstrate how to build a simple yet functional file browser from scratch.
